title: Dental PPO Plans Member Appeals
content:
Appeals policy for the Dental PPO Plans.

**1. Whose appeal.** An appeal is the member's own assertion of the right to review: it is filed by the member, by an authorized representative named in writing by the member, or by the treating practice on the member's behalf, and the agent records it only on the member's instruction.

**2. What can be appealed.** Only an adverse determination: a line with a denial remark, a line paid with the alternate-benefit or reduced-annual-maximum remark, a reprocessed line, or an estimate line with an estimate remark other than covered. The line's remark on the system record decides this.

**3. First-level window (time condition).** A first-level appeal may be filed no later than the appeal filing window after the adverse determination date shown on the Explanation of Benefits. The window is the plan's first-level filing window in calendar days counted from the decision date of the appealed line (or the issue date of the appealed estimate line), and a filing received on the last day of the window is timely.

**4. Second level (time condition and group only).** A second-level appeal exists only for group enrollments, and may be filed no later than the second-level window after the first-level appeal decision. The window is the plan's second-level filing window in calendar days counted from the decision date of the first-level decision, and a filing received on the last day is timely.

**5. One filing per level.** Only one filing per appealed line per level may exist.

**6. Decision due date.** The filing date plus, in calendar days: the pre-service decision period for a pre-service appeal at either level; the group post-service decision period for each level of a post-service appeal on a group enrollment; the individual post-service decision period for the single post-service level on an individual or individual exchange enrollment.

**7. Decisions.** A decision references the filing it decides. Overturned or partially overturned post-service decisions cause the appealed line to be reprocessed on the corrected facts, and an overturned pre-service decision is followed by a new estimate.

**8. Not provided for.** A late filing, a filing on a non-adverse line, a third level, or a request for external review of a dental decision is not provided for by these rules.

### Window boundaries (hypothetical, 60-day second-level window, first-level decision 1 June)
| Second-level filing received | Day count from 1 June | Timely? |
|---|---|---|
| 31 July | 60 | Yes (last day) |
| 1 August | 61 | No |
